items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: and then Dell went to work with Horace Henderson at the Swingland

ctx.x: Yeah, so he had the band. And I stayed there about -- oh, six months or nine months, and then Dell went to work with Horace Henderson at the Swingland, and he went there because -- I guess he wanted a big band thing,

and Horace had a big band and we had only six pieces there. So he turned the band over to me. So I took the band over there, then in 19-- well, I guess about '37, '38, because I'd been there about -- the last part of '37, I think it was. And that's when I took the band over there.
